text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: PRINCESSSSSSSSS~~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tea time ♡ get closer time ♡ 
Totally remember proper tea etiquette,
y'know~

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As stated repeatedly,
coordinate schedules in advance. 
Excuse me, training awaits.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Instant ditch? Big rip!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ding-dooong! You home, Princess?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, how may I assist——

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heeey, My Lady! Love delivery here!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Spicy dance moves! Droppin' all my~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Limitless Love ♡ Daiichi Ruby-tan ♡

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Is that all? Lights-out approaches. 
Wrap this up———

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa—— hol' up, gimme sec! 
Wrote hyper romantic lyrics just for you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Lovey, dovey, Princess~, luv u Princess! 
Hear my love delivery! Take all my love,
yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Shining so bright ♡ Red eyes so ultra
kawaii ♡ 
Party time,
bounce straight to paradise with me!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is lights-out time,
so please excuse me. Good night.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa—! 
Cold shoulder, broken heart,
but still 100% full of love~!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So you're prepping your outfit on the day,
entry all set… 
…You practice every single day.
Is everything going well?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. 
There are no issues at all.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's good. If you need anything,
let me know. 
Practice help or whatever else.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. 
I truly appreciate it—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ojousama, Ojousama~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Love delivery!!
Way more loaded than yesterday! 
See? That's my passion for you, my lady—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but simply bringing flowers 
is not sufficient reason to choose you as
my escort.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh—! Why not! 
I'm crazy about you, ain't that enough?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I understand your feelings. 
However,
that does not meet my standard for an
escort.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I… aim for nothing less than 'Best
Escort.'

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will not force this goal on anyone. However,
I wish 
to choose someone with genuine potential to
win.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, mere declarations of affection 
will not earn my selection.
Please understand.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san,
apologies for the disruption. 
Did you need anything else from me?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ojousama? Best Escort,
right?! Imma give it my all—!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If I'm Best Escort material, you'll pick me,
yeah? 
Win-win! Hype is real!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah~!
Operation Woo Ojousama Phase 2! 
Let's GOOOO—!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: I see… 'Best Escort'… That's why…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
…She's truly incredible. 
If only there was more I could do…

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—Two hours until breakfast. Light jog, 
then dance practice for about an hour and
a half.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Still need to analyze past 'Best Escort'
footage. 
…Must gather more materials if possible.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Ruby. 
Off to practice already?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Forgive me. It seems I woke you.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
Planned on early light training anyway. 
Don't worry.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for 'Best Escort,' right? 
Cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I must claim the title. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: …For your family's sake, right.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
'Best Escort' means a lot to your family,
doesn't it? 
————I understand.
Giving everything for someone else's sake.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If fine with you, may I help? 
Like… gathering past Droite performance
records.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Saw you reviewing old Droite videos. 
If you need more references,
I'll collect them.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Would that not interfere with 
your committee duties?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You are already busy. 
And there are other participants needing
support.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No problem. 
Supporting all participants is my duty.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let me support your dedication too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —…Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Miracle-san is so kind. 
Her encouragement means I must strive
harder.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —…Still not enough.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(More training required.
I must overwhelm all 
with an absolute,
flawless performance. Next time.)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby surges from outside!
Daiichi Ruby is here! 
Can she take it?! Across line,
she's done it!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Unmatched strength from Daiichi Ruby!
Brilliance of 
'Splendid Family' truly blooms in sprinting
world!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Having mastered sprint speed, 
I must pledge future victories and
deliver.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Even in academy life, I must claim 
'Best Escort' and prove my standing.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (————Just like Mother did.)
